title: Add exact business address and fix WhatsApp integration

requirements.summary: Display the exact business address prominently on the website in FindUsSection and footer with Google Maps link using Plus Code
acceptanceCriteria: The full address 'In front of Jagluck Services Pvt Ltd, 3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002' is displayed verbatim on the page.
The address is visible in the FindUsSection and/or footer on the homepage.
The Google Maps link uses the Plus Code 6RRQ+93M and the full address to ensure correct map resolution.
The address text is styled consistently with the cosmic/gold theme (no plain unstyled text).
The address is not paraphrased, truncated, or reworded in any way.

file_operations.description: Update the section to display the exact business address 'In front of Jagluck Services Pvt Ltd, 3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002' verbatim above the CTA button. Update the Google Maps CTA link to 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=6RRQ%2B93M+Jagluck+services+pvt+ltd,+Kotitirtha+Ln,+Old+Town,+Bhubaneswar,+Odisha+751002'. Style the address text with consistent cosmic/gold theme styling using existing Tailwind classes (e.g., text-gold-300, cosmic theme utilities).

Create a new Footer component that displays the exact business address 'In front of Jagluck Services Pvt Ltd, 3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002' verbatim. Include contact information section with the address prominently styled using cosmic/gold theme colors. Use semantic HTML (footer, address tags) and ensure text is readable against the dark cosmic background.
Import and render the new Footer component at the bottom of the HomePage after the BookingForm section to wire the footer into the main page layout.

requirements.summary: Update the JSON-LD LocalBusiness structured data block in index.html to include the exact business address and Plus Code map URL
acceptanceCriteria: The JSON-LD LocalBusiness block in index.html contains an 'address' object with the correct streetAddress, addressLocality ('Bhubaneswar'), addressRegion ('Odisha'), postalCode ('751002'), and addressCountry ('IN').
The 'hasMap' URL uses the Plus Code 6RRQ+93M for accurate map resolution.
No existing JSON-LD fields are removed or broken.

file_operations.description: Update the existing JSON-LD LocalBusiness structured data block to add an 'address' property with PostalAddress schema type. Set streetAddress to '3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town', addressLocality to 'Bhubaneswar', addressRegion to 'Odisha', postalCode to '751002', and addressCountry to 'IN'. Update the 'hasMap' property to 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=6RRQ%2B93M+Jagluck+services+pvt+ltd,+Kotitirtha+Ln,+Old+Town,+Bhubaneswar,+Odisha+751002'. Preserve all existing JSON-LD fields and ensure valid JSON syntax.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix WhatsApp deep link integration to use correct international format +918689838590 in BookingForm and AdminPage
acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp deep link in BookingForm.tsx uses 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=...' with the correct international format.
The WhatsApp deep link in AdminPage.tsx (pending bookings alert) also uses the same corrected number 918689838590.
The pre-filled message includes booking details (customer name, service type, booking category, preferred date, phone number).
Clicking the WhatsApp button on a mobile device opens WhatsApp with the correct number and pre-filled message.
No spaces, dashes, or extra characters appear in the phone number portion of the URL.

file_operations.description: Update the WhatsApp deep-link generation to use the format 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=<urlencoded message>' with the correct international phone number 918689838590 (no spaces, dashes, or formatting). Ensure the pre-filled message includes all booking details: customer name, service type, booking category, preferred date, and customer phone number. URL-encode the message text properly.

Update the WhatsApp alert link for pending bookings to use the corrected phone number 918689838590 in the format 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=<urlencoded message>'. Ensure no spaces, dashes, or extra characters are present in the phone number portion of the URL. Verify the message parameter is properly URL-encoded.
